Barog.desc: A station on the Kalka–Shimla toy train line, one of the few stops on the heritage narrow-gauge railway. The Him Darshan Express from Shimla makes a scheduled stop at Barog; the town is a quiet halt on the NH-5 road between Kalka and Solan. (sourced from r/india_tourism toy train post)

Solan.desc: Solan is a town on the Shimla–Kalka highway in Himachal Pradesh, best known as the gateway to Kasauli and for the historic Dagshai and Karol breweries around it. It is a regular stop on the Kalka–Shimla road trip, about 50 km from Chandigarh. (sourced from Shimla road trip posts)
